title: DeepSeek Harness connection
description: Connect DeepSeek Harness from Integrations using a ready-to-install Preflyt plugin link. The connector uses the desktop app runtime and a pinned OAuth bridge, then asks you to approve specific repositories. DeepSeek can read saved findings and source excerpts and submit attributed review evidence; it cannot change scan outcomes or merge decisions.
upgrade: Recreate matching API, worker and web services. Install the Preflyt connector in DeepSeek Harness and approve only the repositories it needs.
